description.value: Uncle Fatih's Pizza is a Metro Vancouver pizza chain with 12 locations, serving freshly made pies on daily-prepared dough with non-hydrogenated ingredients and an emphasis on vegetables over cheese. The Brentwood, Burnaby outpost offers a relaxed indoor dining room along with robust takeout and online ordering. The menu spans meat and vegetarian specialties, with vegan cheese (Daiya), gluten-free crust (OGGI brand), and halal chicken available.
